grades.quote: FCVT.W.D or FCVT.L.D converts a double-precision floating-point number in floating-point register _rs1_ to a signed 32-bit or 64-bit integer, respectively, in integer register _rd_ .
grades.reason: This passage covers the double-precision FCVT.W.D conversion, not FCVT.W.S or FMV.X.W. It shows that FCVT instructions convert numeric values and round according to rm, and it says FCVT.int.D behaves like FCVT.int.S. That is limited auxiliary context for the numeric-conversion side only. It doesn't mention FMV.X.W or the bit-pattern transfer.

This passage is about the half-precision Zfhmin subset, which includes FMV.X.H and FCVT.S.H. It doesn't discuss FMV.X.W or FCVT.W.S, and it doesn't explain the difference between a bit-pattern move and a numeric conversion.
This passage describes the Zfa round-to-integer instructions FROUND and FROUNDNX. They are unrelated to the difference between FMV.X.W and FCVT.W.S.
